payload.credit_html: Gai Z, Lu L, Zhao W, Zhu M (2018) New polybranchiaspiform fishes (Agnatha: Galeaspida) from the Middle Palaeozoic of China and their ecomorphological implications. PLoS ONE 13(9): e0202217. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0202217
payload.description_html: Ecological restoration of galeapids during the Pragian showing three different types of habits (illustrated by Dinghua Yang). Bottom: Nanningaspis lived in a semi-infaunal benthic (half buried) habit; middle: Dongfangaspis lived in a epibenthic habit; top: Rhegmaspis lived in a suprabenthic (nektonic) habit.
